A classic-fit, lightweight t-shirt featuring Miles Morales from Spider-Man: Spider-Verse, sold as officially licensed Marvel apparel. It has double-needle stitching on the sleeves and bottom hem. Item number 18MARF00284A. The color is not specified in the listing.

specs.use: Party, cosplay, Halloween, and gift use
specs.light vs. dark hair: Best on light hair; dark hair may need water first

record.description: A 10-color temporary hair chalk set with a built-in comb for parties, cosplay, and holidays. Colors wash out with shampoo and water and can be mixed. Works best on light hair; darker hair may need a little water first. Listed for ages 3 and up. Shades may differ slightly from photos.

Hue women's ultra low, no-show liner socks in black, sold as a 3-pair pack. They have a mesh top, a cushioned ventilated sole, and a silicone grip on the heel. The listing gives a size of 9-11 and says they fit shoe sizes 4-10.

The Denon AVR-S540BT is a 5.2-channel home theater receiver rated at 140W per channel. It supports 4K Ultra HD video with HDR, HLG and BT.2020, and includes built-in Bluetooth and a USB port. HEOS Link compatibility allows wireless music streaming and multi-room audio. An on-screen setup assistant guides initial connections, and four front-panel buttons store preferred audio settings.

A foldable, portable vocal booth for recording and podcasting, sized 12 x 14 x 16 inches inside after setup. Its wood panels are lined with 2-inch high-density egg crate foam to absorb reflections and reduce ambient noise. It can sit on a table or mount on a mic stand, folds flat for travel, and weighs 3.8 pounds. Black finish.

specs.material: 100% cotton washed canvas front, 100% polyester mesh back

record.description: A structured, medium-profile men's cap in Musk Green from Carhartt, one size fits all. The front is washed cotton canvas and the back is polyester mesh. It has a pre-curved sandwich visor, a Carhartt Force sweatband with FastDry technology, and a Carhartt patch on the front.

The Epson EF-100 is a black laser projector with built-in Android TV and Google Assistant voice search, controlled by a simple remote. It projects images up to 150 inches and includes an internal bass-reflex speaker plus a 3.5mm stereo output. Its compact, modern design is available in black, white, silver, or black and copper.

specs.design: Contrasting Swoosh from heel to midfoot

record.description: Women's Nike Court Royale AC sneakers in black and white, size 8.5 Regular US. The leather upper has a retro tennis look, with traditional lace-up closure and a contrasting Swoosh running from heel to midfoot. Features a solid rubber outsole with herringbone pattern, autoclave construction, and a soft fabric lining with comfort footbed.

specs.tablet pocket: Fits mini tablet up to 7.9 inches

record.description: A black, water-resistant nylon travel organizer for cables, chargers, and small electronics. It has two zippers, two layers, and elastic loops and mesh pockets for cables and USB drives. A dedicated pocket holds a mini tablet up to 7.9 inches, and a detachable hand strap aids carrying. It measures about 9.8 x 6.5 x 6.5 inches and weighs 173 grams.

The Under Armour Women's Favorite Tote 2.0 in Hushed Turquoise is a 25-liter bag with a highly water-resistant UA Storm finish. It features a large main compartment, an oversized wordmark zipper pull, and double webbing straps for carrying. When full, it measures 20.3" wide, 12.6" long, and 9.8" high.

The Nike Air Zoom Mariah Flyknit Racer is a shoe from the Nike line. It has a Flyknit upper with a sock-like fit, Zoom Air cushioning, a heel pull tab, and a rubber outsole. The listed SKU is 918264-200, size 10.5.

specs.material: Fiberglass mesh with thickened webbing edges
specs.included: Hook and loop roll, push pins, instruction manual

record.description: A magnetic fiberglass screen door curtain sized 38 by 81 inches to fit a 36 by 80 inch door. It has thickened webbing on all four edges, double-stitched reinforcement at the top middle, and hook-and-loop fasteners at the middle and bottom to resist wind. The 18 by 16 mesh allows airflow and light. Included: hook-and-loop roll, push pins, and instructions.

A 5x8 foot teal blue shag rug with a 1.57-inch plush pile and a dense sponge middle layer for softness and sound absorption. Anti-slip dots on the underside help it stay in place, though moisture underneath can cause slipping. Arrives vacuum packed, so wrinkles may appear; airing it out for a few days is recommended.

specs.care: Cold machine or hand wash; do not bleach

record.description: A blue long-sleeve popover shirt in size 3XL from the Dioufond brand, made of 80% cotton and 20% polyester. It has a mandarin collar, chest buttons, roll-tab sleeves, and a regular fit with a straight-cut hem. The listing recommends cold machine or hand washing, no bleach, and hang or low-heat drying.

specs.putting surface: approx. 2 ft x 8.5 ft inside border

record.description: A 3-by-10-foot putting mat from JEF World of Golf, with roughly 2 by 8.5 feet of premium turf inside the border. It includes two holes with flags and has a padded rubber base. The listing describes it for indoor or outdoor use.

A manual focus prime lens from 7artisans with a 35mm focal length and a maximum aperture of F1.2, designed for APS-C mirrorless cameras with a Canon EOS-M mount. It has a 6-element, 5-group optical design, a crescent-shaped focus ring, multi-layer coating, and a copper core aluminum shell. Sold in black.

specs.controls: Remote with 2H/4H/6H/8H timers, flicker or steady mode, brightness levels

record.description: A set of two ivory frosted plastic flameless candles, each 6 inches tall and 3.25 inches wide. They feature a flickering flame effect and are rated waterproof for outdoor use. Each runs on two AA batteries. A remote control adjusts mode and brightness and sets 2, 4, 6, or 8 hour timers. The set includes the remote and a manual.

specs.type: Thermal base layer set (long sleeve shirt or long johns)

record.description: STARK SOUL men's thermal base layer set in black and blue, sizes L/XL, sold as a long-sleeve shirt or long johns. Made from high-elasticity sports fabric with a double-seamless construction and three-dimensional elastic zones for freedom of movement. Suited to autumn and winter use in activities such as hiking, skiing, and cycling.

specs.compatible_device: Mini S530 Bluetooth earbuds and headphones

record.description: A 30 cm (11.8 inch) USB charging cable with a 2.0 mm by 12.0 mm DC tip, designed to charge Mini S530 Bluetooth earbuds and headphones. It can plug into wall adapters, laptop or PC USB ports, power banks, or car chargers. Not compatible with B&O Earset 2 or Blue Parrot headsets. Measure your device's charging plug before ordering.

specs.feature: Front pull tab for kids and adults
specs.decoration: Polyester felt animal appliqué on front

record.description: A 13-inch cube storage box made of 100% polyester, designed to fit most cube shelving units. It features a front pull tab that lets both children and adults easily remove it, and a polyester felt dog appliqué on the front.

specs.cooling: Holds ice; keeps contents cold for at least 7 hours

record.description: A grey, 15-liter insulated lunch bag with a double-deck layout that keeps upper and lower foods separate. It has a seamless, thickened PEVA liner that is leakproof and easy to wipe clean. The insulated lining can hold ice to keep contents cold, and the bag weighs about 1.5 pounds. Suitable for work, picnics, and everyday carrying.

specs.care: Oven, microwave, freezer and dishwasher safe

record.description: A set of four multicolor stoneware rice bowls from the Heritage Terrace collection by Denby, made in England. The bowls are handcrafted and suitable for use in the oven, microwave, and freezer, and they can be cleaned in the dishwasher.

specs.product type: Corrugate cat scratcher and lounge chaise
specs.infusion: Catnip infused between each corrugate layer
specs.functions: Upright block scratcher, floor scratcher, and lounging chaise

record.description: The SmartyKat Super Scratcher Chaise is a corrugated cardboard cat scratcher that doubles as a lounge. Catnip is placed between each layer of corrugate during manufacturing, so its scent is released as your cat scratches. The shape works as an upright block, a floor scratcher, and a chaise for lounging. The product is made in the USA.

specs.style: Sleeveless lace fit and flare midi dress

record.description: A sleeveless midi dress in navy lace with a fit-and-flare silhouette. It has a contemporary fit that runs small, so consider sizing up if between sizes. The dress is partially lined. Size M corresponds to US 6-8.

A single 8.4 fl oz bottle of L'Occitane Cherry Blossom bath and shower gel. It is designed to cleanse the skin and leave a light cherry blossom fragrance. Apply to wet skin, lather, and rinse. Listed as suitable for sensitive skin.

specs.package dimensions: 3.12 in L x 3.12 in W x 5.06 in H

record.description: The WIX 57502XP is an automotive oil filter from the brand WIX, listed under model number 57502XP. The product has a package weight of 0.75 pounds and measures about 3.12 by 3.12 by 5.06 inches. It is listed as made in China.

A large sand-resistant blanket measuring about 82.7 by 78.7 inches, suited to 4 to 8 adults. Made of nylon, it is water-resistant and dries quickly. It folds compactly and weighs 12 ounces. Four pockets hold small items, and four ground stakes help secure it in wind. Suitable for beaches, picnics, and camping.
A navy and grey boat shoe from Sperry's Cruise line, sized Big Kid 5. It has a leather-like upper, a lace-up closure, a memory foam footbed, and a cupsole with a rubber outsole for traction.

specs.style: Classic Short rubber logo fashion boot

record.description: A women's short fashion boot in black, sized 8 M US, with a soft suede upper and a UGG logo rubber print on the front shaft. It has a 17 mm UGGpure lining and insole and a Treadlite by UGG outsole.

specs.material: Glossy smooth vinyl with linen lining
specs.straps: Adjustable pink poly-webbing neck and long waist ties

record.description: A pink waterproof vinyl apron with a glossy, smooth surface that wipes clean easily. It is described as ultra lightweight and suited to kitchen, food prep, garden, and garage work. It has adjustable pink poly-webbing neck straps and long waist ties, and measures 12 inches across the neck, 22 inches along the bottom, and 29 inches in height.

A full-motion wall bracket for TVs and monitors from 13 to 30 inches, rated for up to 33 lbs. It supports 75x75mm and 100x100mm VESA patterns, tilts ±15°, swivels up to ±90° depending on screen size, and rotates 360°. The arm extends up to 14 inches and collapses to about 2 inches.

This three-tier corner shelf is fan-shaped and made from lightweight paulownia wood, hung on jute rope. Each shelf is 11 inches in radius and 0.7 inches thick, with a torched, dark brown finish. Recommended load is 10 pounds per shelf. It mounts to a nail, screw, or hook in a corner and the rope is adjusted to level.

A girl's clothing set from Hudson in a blueberry print, sized 12-18 months. The set includes coordinating dresses made from 100% cotton. The listing describes the fabric as soft and comfortable on baby's skin and suitable for everyday wear. Color is not specified.

Pack of 50 disposable dog training pads, measuring 22 by 23 inches, for dogs of all sizes. Each pad has a rapid-drying top layer intended to limit tracking, a gel layer meant to lock in liquid, and a built-in attractant meant to encourage use. The pads are scented with Febreze freshness and are marketed to help reduce urine odor.

A collapsible wall-mounted rack for air-drying or hanging clothes. Its ABS plastic mount and stainless steel rod support up to 60 lbs, with 12 inches of hanging space when open. Folds to 18 by 3 by 2 inches. Includes anchors and screws for drywall, masonry, or wood. Sold as a 2-pack.

specs.lettering: Black OVERSIZE LOAD, 2 in x 12 in letters
specs.features: Tear and UV resistant, breathable
specs.use: Mounts to front or back of most vehicles

record.description: A yellow nylon mesh banner, 18 by 84 inches, reading OVERSIZE LOAD in black letters. It has brass grommets for mounting to the front or back of a vehicle and black edge binding. Used to mark oversize hauls such as equipment, boats, and modular homes.

A neon green set of 48 two-piece floating golf balls from A99, made for practice in and around water. Each ball has 432 dimples, a 90 compression rating, and an injection-molded Surlyn cover. A carry bag is included for transport.

specs.faucet_connection: Universal faucet adapter with Quick Connect

record.description: A compact white countertop dishwasher from SPT, model SD-2225DW, with a stainless steel interior and room for six place settings. It offers six wash cycles (Heavy, Normal, ECO, Glass, Speed and Rinse), delay start options of 2, 4, 6 or 8 hours, and a universal faucet adapter with Quick Connect. Electronic controls show remaining time on an LED display.

specs.included_items: Bain-marie, decorating stands, and baking and decorating gadgets

record.description: A DIY cake pop maker toy from AMAV Toys for children aged 6 and up. The set includes a bain-marie, decorating stands, and baking and decorating gadgets, along with a color-printed recipes booklet. Food is not included; you will need your own ingredients. The listing claims cake pops can be baked in about 30 seconds without an oven.

A swivel faucet aerator and sprayer head attachment for round kitchen and bathroom faucets. It rotates 720 degrees and offers soft and strong spray modes. Made of solid brass with a polished, electroplated finish, it is designed to be installed without tools and to produce an air-infused stream that reduces splashing.

specs.midsole: Bounce with Boost in the heel
specs.recycled content: Upper contains a minimum of 50% recycled content

record.description: A men's golf shoe from adidas in grey, green, and black, size 10 US. It has a regular fit, a lace closure, and a mesh and synthetic upper. The midsole uses Bounce cushioning, with Boost in the heel. The upper is made with at least 50% recycled content through adidas's Primegreen materials.
A men's Carolina straw hat by Stetson & Dobbs, model OSCLNA-3832, in natural color and size XL. It has an Outback-style brim and a vented crown.

Two clear acrylic apothecary jars, 15 oz and 20 oz, for storing cotton swabs, cotton balls, cotton rounds, makeup sponges, and bath salts. Each has a removable lid and a wide mouth for easy access. The plastic resembles glass without the risk of shattering. Backed by a 1-year warranty.

specs.features: Card holder slot, kickstand, swivel belt clip
specs.included: 1 hybrid case, 1 tempered glass screen protector
specs.sold by: Ships from USA, phone not included

record.description: A rose gold protective case with a brushed metal texture, built as a two-layer hybrid with a rubberized inner layer and a harder outer shell. It is made for the Samsung Galaxy On5, includes a card holder slot, a kickstand, and a swivel belt clip, and comes with one tempered glass screen protector. The phone is not included.

A portable electric facial hair remover from Keenove (model Ke-208) for women, designed for use on the face, including the lips, cheeks, and chin. It uses a 180 professional motor and dual stainless steel blades to remove fine and coarse hair, and includes one replacement head. The body is made of PTEE material.

A two-person camping hammock from Overmont, built from seamless 210T nylon taffeta with a double layer that is black on one side and orange on the other. It measures 8.9 by 4.6 feet, is rated to 880 lbs, and includes two 9.8-foot straps and two carabiner clips. It stores in an attached bag and is TUV certified.

The Midlee Dog Reindeer Costume in Medium is a hoodie-style outfit styled as a reindeer for dogs, fastened with Velcro at the neck and chest. The listing gives conflicting measurements, so check the bullet-point sizing (10-inch neck, 14-inch chest, 12-inch back) and the description figures (12, 16, 14 inches) against your dog before ordering.

A height-adjustable desk with a 47 by 30 inch wooden top on a metal frame, rated for 165 lbs. Dual motors raise it from 29 to 49 inches, and the top tilts from 13 to 45 degrees. A touch panel provides presets and a child lock, plus two USB charging ports.

A 10-piece set of pirate-themed toy figures from Wild Republic, including five pirates, a two-piece cannon, a treasure chest, an eye patch, and a flag. Figures measure about 1 to 2.5 inches, suit ages 3 and up, and are made without phthalates or lead. Wipe clean with soap and water.

specs.cushioning: Gel pads in heel and forefoot

record.description: Sof Sole blue men's performance insoles, trim-to-fit for men's sizes 9 to 10.5. They have a contoured neutral arch for most foot types and gel pads under the heel and forefoot. The Hydrologix treatment wicks moisture, and the insoles suit walking, running, cross training, and casual wear.

specs.upholstery: Soft polyester fabric with piped trim
specs.legs: Dark walnut stained wood with non-marking caps

record.description: A mid-century modern accent armchair in azure, with a curved back, cut-out silhouette, and gentle recline. It has polyester fabric upholstery with piped trim and dark walnut-stained wood legs fitted with non-marking caps. Overall measures 28.5" long by 27.5" wide by 31" high, with a 440-pound weight capacity.

A round, two-tier stainless steel lunch container in white, with a twist-open lid and locked clips that hold the tiers together. The listing describes a vacuum-tight seal meant to limit leaks and spills, and states the container is BPA free, dishwasher safe, and freezer safe. It is sold for soup and hot food.

HUE women's knit Bermuda pajama sleep shorts in Chambray Blue-Blinglasses, size Large. These relaxed-fit shorts have an elastic waistband and a 10.5-inch inseam. The print is a hand-drawn design from the HUE NYC studio team.

specs.included_accessories: Optional hands, head, backpack, holographic wings, 2 weapons
specs.transformation: Flying mode via detachable wing gears

record.description: A 6-inch, fully articulated Falcon action figure from Marvel's Avengers: Infinity War, part of Bandai's S.H.Figuarts line. It can be posed in a flying mode using detachable wing gears. Accessories include optional hands, a head, a backpack for the wings, holographic wings, and two weapons. Recommended for ages 15 and up.

A red radiator grille decal sticker for the 2018 Kia Stinger, sold as one set. It is made in Korea, is new, and is designed to be applied to the front radiator grille. Installation uses adhesive double-sided tape, and the listing describes it as a precise 3D-designed fit.

specs.packaging note: Eye paint difference is intentionally subtle

record.description: A stylized vinyl figure of Thor from Marvel's Avengers: Endgame, produced by Funko as part of its Pop! line. The collectible stands about 3.75 inches tall and is designed to be displayed alongside other figures from the same film. The listing notes that the eye paint difference is intentionally subtle and is easiest to see outside the packaging.

specs.sizing: Standard US, fits adults and kids

record.description: Joyfunny My Hero Academia training sweatpants in Type F, XX-Large, themed after characters including Izuku, Froppy, Tsuyu Asui and Ochaco Uraraka. Made from 100% cotton, listed as new, and sized to the standard US scale for adults and kids. Suited to everyday wear, cosplay, Halloween, theme parties and as an anime fan gift.

A 9-foot beige table umbrella for patio and outdoor use, with a 100% polyester canopy, eight steel ribs, and a 1.5-inch steel pole with a rust-resistant powder-coated finish. It opens and closes with a crank, and the push-button tilt lets you adjust the angle to follow the sun. Includes a wind vent. The base is not included.

A children's gardening kit that lets kids grow their own zinnia, marigold, and cosmo flowers. Included is a tin planter with a liner, two coconut fiber pucks, a paintbrush, and a six-color paint strip for decorating. Stake holders help keep plantings organized, and easy-to-follow instructions are provided.

A men's hiking shoe in walnut, size 10.5 M US, with a performance suede leather and mesh upper and a breathable mesh lining. The bellows-style tongue is padded with closed-cell foam to help keep moisture and debris out. A rubber toe cap adds protection, and the outsole is a Vibram TC5-plus with 5mm lug depth.

specs.interior: Fully lined, tear-resistant, with zippered organizer pockets
specs.grip_handles: Top, bottom, and side grab handles

record.description: A navy 20-inch carry-on suitcase from Ben Sherman with a hard ABS shell and four multi-directional spinner wheels. It has a telescoping trolley handle that extends to 41 inches, grab handles on the top, bottom, and side, and a fully lined interior with zippered organizer pockets and a garment restraint panel.

specs.care: Hand wash cold; do not bleach; hang or line dry
specs.style: Classic draped open front lightweight blazer
specs.sleeve: Long sleeve (listing also mentions 3/4 sleeve versions)

record.description: A lightweight open-front blazer in red, size Small, from Doublju's plus-size line. Made of soft rayon with some stretch, it has a draped front. Hand wash cold, do not bleach, and hang or line dry. Long-sleeve and 3/4-sleeve versions are listed. Screen colors may differ from the actual item.

specs.age range: Listed as 3-7 in title, 5+ in bullets
specs.use: Indoor or outdoor building, blanket not included

record.description: A 120-piece fort-building set for children, made of solid plastic. Includes 75 sticks about 15 inches long and 45 connector balls (23 blue, 22 green), each about 2 inches across. Pieces twist together and come apart again. Comes with a storage bag and works indoors or outdoors. Blanket not included.

specs.material: Memory foam with Rutilated Quartz Nano heating elements
specs.battery life: Up to 5 hours (3-4 h high, 5-6 h low)
specs.temperature settings: Three adjustable levels with power display
specs.warranty: One-year free warranty; 30-day replacement or refund

record.description: Rechargeable heated insoles from BIAL with memory foam construction and three adjustable heat settings. A power display shows remaining charge. Sold in S (US 4-7), M (US 8-11) and L (US 12-15) sizes, and the heating area can be trimmed to fit. Listed battery life is 3 to 6 hours depending on heat level, and the insoles are washable.

Jessica Simpson model J5596 women's aviator sunglasses with a lightweight metal frame and polycarbonate lenses in a gradient brown tint. The lenses carry a UV-protective coating. Measurements are 60 mm lens width, 140 mm temple length, and 18 mm bridge width. A soft microfiber pouch is included.

specs.care: Machine washable

record.description: Men's large compression pants in a 92% polyester, 8% spandex blend, worn under jerseys, tights, or shorts for sports. Tight fit with a 34–35 inch waist and 34.5–35 inch length. Rated UPF 30 for sun protection and machine washable.

A men's heavyweight car coat in black, sized small, made from a wool blend twill. It has a button-front closure and a roomy fit through the chest and waist. The listing describes the fabric as thick, warm, and soft. It is sold under the Amazon Essentials brand.

A pack of 12 large decorative gift bows in silver metallic foil, each about 4.5 inches across. The bows have a self-adhesive backing for easy attachment to gift wrap or packages. They have a traditional bow style and pair with other ribbon and bow products from the same brand, which are sold separately.

specs.charging_ports: Dual USB, one QC 3.0 fast-charge port and one 2.4A port

record.description: A compact orange Bluetooth FM transmitter for cars, with a 1.6 x 1.6 inch body and four buttons. It offers Bluetooth 5.0 audio and hands-free calling, plays music from a USB drive, TF card or Bluetooth source, and includes two USB ports, one of them QC 3.0 fast-charge. It also has an LED backlight with seven colors.

specs.compatibility: Fits most standard 32 oz. jelly jars

record.description: A red oriole jelly feeder from Perky-Pet, model 253, with a 32 oz. capacity. Its inverted bottle design holds the jelly, and an internal stirrer is meant to dispense it in measured amounts. The bottle can be swapped with most standard 32 oz. jelly jars, and the feeder is designed to be easy to clean.

specs.set contents: 1 flat (114" x 114"), 1 fitted (78" x 80" x 17"), 2 pillowcases (22" x 42")
specs.trim: Double colored satin stitch rows on flat sheet and pillowcases
specs.care: Machine wash warm, gentle cycle, non-chlorine bleach; tumble dry low

record.description: Sferra's Grande Hotel king sheet set comes in crisp white with a grey accent. It includes a flat sheet, a fitted sheet, and two pillowcases, made in Italy from 200-thread-count 100% Italian Egyptian cotton percale. The flat sheet and pillowcases feature double rows of colored satin stitching; the fitted sheet does not. Machine washable on a gentle cycle.

Ten white 42mm (1.65-inch) festoon LED bulbs, each with 16 SMD 3528 LEDs and a rated 6000K color temperature. Listed as 12V for replacing interior dome, map, trunk, and cargo lights, with compatibility noted for several part numbers. Rated for 50,000 working hours. If a bulb does not light, rotate it 180 degrees.

The Millennium Marine SW-200 is a gray boat seat measuring 18" long, 21" wide, and 6" high. It weighs 8 lbs and has a 400 lb weight capacity. The seat is designed to mount to most boat pedestals and comes with a 3-year warranty.

specs.formula: Cream, ready to use, no developer required
specs.recommended prep: Lighten hair to level 8 or lighter; level 9-10 for best results
specs.compatibility: Can be mixed with other MANIC PANIC colors and the Pastelizer

record.description: A deep, cool fuchsia semi-permanent cream dye that needs no developer. It is free from ammonia, parabens, gluten, resorcinol and phthalates, and is vegan and PETA accredited. Color fades over four to six weeks. Lightening hair first gives the most vivid results. It can be mixed with other shades or the Pastelizer.

A women's mid-ankle hiking boot in dark brown, size 5 M US, from Timberland. It has a leather upper, a waterproof construction, shock-absorbing cushioning, and a rubber lug outsole for traction on trails. The listing describes it as suited to outdoor use.

A men's Under Armour cap in Academy Blue with red accents, sized X-Large/XX-Large. It has a Classic Fit, a pre-curved visor, and a structured front panel with foam padding. The fabric uses UA Microthread, and the cap includes built-in HeatGear.
A red Daewoo microwave oven with 0.7 cubic feet of capacity, model KOR07R3ZER. Includes a turntable for even heating. Suited to a home kitchen.

A royal blue flower crown headband and hair wreath from Love Sweety, handmade with a 19 cm (about 7.48 inch) diameter that fits most heads. Suited to weddings, festivals, and photo shoots, and worn by brides, bridesmaids, flower girls, or anyone wanting a decorative floral accent.

specs.storage features: Cup holder, headphone hook, cable tray, two speaker/CD holders

record.description: A black Z-shaped gaming desk measuring 42.5 by 23.6 by 27.56 inches, with a curved carbon fiber top rated to hold up to 280 pounds. It includes a cup holder, headphone hook, cable tray, and two speaker or CD holders. The metal frame is built into the Z-shaped legs, which have suction cup feet, and assembly instructions are included.

specs.barrel length: Extra long, 2 inches longer than typical irons

record.description: A 1-inch gold-finished curling iron from Hot Tools, model HT1181XL, with an extra-long barrel that the listing describes as two inches longer than typical irons. It reaches up to 430 degrees and uses a rheostat dial for temperature control. It has a rotating cool tip and includes a heat-resistant mat to protect countertops.

specs.construction: Breathable knit with grip injection technology
specs.care: Machine washable

record.description: Mad Grip F50 Thunderdome impact gloves in size Large and high-visibility orange. Constructed from breathable knit with grip injection technology, they feature seamless reinforcement in high-abrasion areas and are machine washable. Designed for hand protection and handling of large and small parts.

specs.suspension: Telescopic front forks, rear mono shock

record.description: A blue 50cc two-stroke, air-cooled kids' dirt bike from MotoTec. It has a pull-start engine, fully automatic transmission, and a restrictable throttle for speed control. The chromoly steel frame has telescopic front forks, a rear mono shock, and disc brakes. The bike is CE and EPA approved.

A black 6000 mAh lithium-polymer battery case for iPhone 6, 6s, 7 and 8 (4.7-inch). It charges the phone through the case, and the phone can sync to a computer while inside. Operated manually with a power button. No charging cable is included, and it does not support wireless charging, CarPlay, or screen protection.

specs.construction: 3-layer hybrid: polycarbonate shell with TPU liner
specs.bezel_protection: Raised lip, about 2mm above screen and 3mm above camera
specs.cutouts: Large cutouts for buttons, ports and speakers

record.description: A rose gold glitter phone case designed for the Apple iPhone XR (6.1 inch). It uses a three-layer construction with a hard outer shell and a soft clear inner liner, and has a raised lip around the screen and camera. Large cutouts give access to buttons, ports, and speakers. Sold as a single case.

A purple wallet-style flip case for the Samsung Galaxy S20 5G (6.2-inch). It holds nine cards plus a zipper coin pocket and two side pockets, and includes a detachable leather wrist strap. Made of PU leather over a soft TPU base, it closes with a magnetic flap and folds into a kickstand.

specs.securing: Tuck under water tubes or use reinforced tie-down loops
specs.use: Placed on top of winter pool cover before leaves fall

record.description: A black knitted polyethylene net for a 16 by 32 foot rectangular pool. Placed over a winter cover before leaves fall, it is meant to catch leaves so they do not settle on the cover or in the water. It can be secured by tucking it under water tubes or using the reinforced tie-down loops.

A set of five blue polyurethane replacement casters for office chairs, with a 7/16 inch standard stem. The listing describes them as quiet-rolling, suitable for hardwood, laminate, tile, and carpet floors, and fitted with ABEC9 bearings. It states the wheels are covered by a U.S. utility patent.

Refurbished Apple iPhone 8 (US version) with 64GB storage in Space Gray. This unit is locked to AT&T and will not work with other carriers, so confirm compatibility first. A vintage-style school bell made of solid polished brass, fitted with a wooden handle. It measures 12 inches high by 5.5 inches long and works as both a decorative piece and a functional hand bell. Sold under the INsideOUT brand in the Office & School Supplies category.

A long-sleeve fishing shirt in Key West/Vivid Blue, size Medium, with a classic fit. Carter's 7-pack of long-sleeve bodysuits for baby girls, size 18 months, in an assorted pack. Each bodysuit has strong snaps for closure. Color is not specified in the listing.

Six Bath & Body Works Sweet Cinnamon Pumpkin Wallflower refill bulbs, packed as three twin-packs. The scent combines spicy pumpkin with sweet butter and vanilla cream. Designed for use with Wallflower fragrance plugs or night-lights. This fragrance is discontinued.

A Hyperkin HDTV cable for the Sega Saturn console, offering 720p output for compatible HDTVs and working with all Saturn models. The 7-foot cable is paired with a 6-foot micro cable included in the package.
